items.source: Exception - if a registered TestExecutionListener throws an exception
items.translation: Exception - 如果注册的 TestExecutionListener 抛出异常

items.source: Each registered TestExecutionListener will be given a chance to perform its post-processing. If a listener throws an exception, the remaining registered listeners will still be called. After all listeners have executed, the first caught exception will be rethrown with any subsequent exceptions suppressed in the first exception.
items.translation: 每个已注册的 TestExecutionListener 都将有机会执行其后期处理。如果某个监听器抛出异常，剩余的已注册监听器仍将被调用。在所有监听器执行完毕后，第一个捕获的异常将重新抛出，并在其中附加（suppressed）后续发生的任何异常。

items.source:
Note that listeners will be executed in the opposite order in which they
were registered.
items.translation: 注意，监听器将以与注册顺序相反的顺序执行。

items.source: testInstance - the current test instance
items.translation: testInstance - 当前测试实例

items.source: The managed TestContext will be updated with the supplied testInstance, testMethod, and exception.
items.translation: 受管理的TestContext将使用提供的testInstance、testMethod和exception进行更新。

items.source: The managed TestContext will be updated with the supplied testInstance and testMethod.
items.translation: 受管理的TestContext将使用提供的testInstance和testMethod进行更新。

items.source: An attempt will be made to give each registered TestExecutionListener a chance to perform its pre-processing. If a listener throws an exception, however, the remaining registered listeners will not be called.
items.translation: 将尝试为每个已注册的TestExecutionListener提供机会以执行其预处理。然而，如果某个监听器抛出异常，则剩余的注册监听器将不会被调用。

items.source: Get the TestContext managed by this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 获取由该TestContextManager管理的TestContext。

items.source: Register the supplied list of TestExecutionListeners by appending them to the list of listeners used by this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 注册提供的 TestExecutionListeners 列表，将其追加到此 TestContextManager 使用的监听器列表中。

items.source: Register the supplied array of TestExecutionListeners by appending them to the list of listeners used by this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 注册提供的 TestExecutionListeners 数组，将其追加到此 TestContextManager 使用的监听器列表中。

items.source: testMethod - the test method which is about to be executed on the test instance
items.translation: testMethod - 即将在测试实例上执行的测试方法

items.source: Delegates to TestContextManager(TestContextBootstrapper) with the TestContextBootstrapper configured for the test class. If the @BootstrapWith annotation is present on the test class, either directly or as a meta-annotation, then its value will be used as the bootstrapper type; otherwise, the DefaultTestContextBootstrapper will be used.
items.translation: 委托给使用为测试类配置的TestContextBootstrapper的TestContextManager(TestContextBootstrapper)。如果测试类上存在（直接地或作为元注解）@BootstrapWith 注解，则使用其value作为引导器类型；否则，将使用DefaultTestContextBootstrapper。

items.source: Support for loading and accessing application contexts, dependency injection of test instances, transactional execution of test methods, etc. is provided by ContextLoaders and TestExecutionListeners, which are configured via @ContextConfiguration and @TestExecutionListeners, respectively.
items.translation: 支持加载和访问 application contexts、测试实例的依赖注入、transactional 测试方法的执行等功能，由 ContextLoaders 和 TestExecutionListeners 提供，它们分别通过 @ContextConfiguration 和 @TestExecutionListeners 进行配置。

items.source: This method must be called immediately prior to framework-specific before lifecycle callbacks — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @BeforeEach. For historical reasons, this method is named beforeTestMethod. Since the introduction of beforeTestExecution(Object, Method), a more suitable name for this method might be something like beforeTestSetUp or beforeEach; however, it is unfortunately impossible to rename this method due to backward compatibility concerns.
items.translation: 此方法必须在框架特定的before生命周期回调之前立即调用——例如，使用 JUnit Jupiter 的 @BeforeEach 注解的方法。出于历史原因，此方法命名为beforeTestMethod。自引入 beforeTestExecution(Object, Method)以来，此方法的更合适名称可能是beforeTestSetUp或beforeEach；然而，由于向后兼容性的问题，不幸的是无法重命名此方法。

items.source: This method must be called immediately after framework-specific after lifecycle callbacks — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @AfterEach. For historical reasons, this method is named afterTestMethod. Since the introduction of afterTestExecution(Object, Method, Throwable), a more suitable name for this method might be something like afterTestTearDown or afterEach; however, it is unfortunately impossible to rename this method due to backward compatibility concerns.
items.translation: 此方法必须在框架特定的after生命周期回调之后立即调用——例如，使用 JUnit Jupiter 的 @AfterEach 注解的方法。出于历史原因，此方法被命名为afterTestMethod。自从引入afterTestExecution(Object, Method, Throwable)以来，此方法的更合适名称可能是afterTestTearDown或afterEach；然而，由于向后兼容性的问题，很遗憾无法重命名此方法。

items.source: Bootstrapping of the TestContext, the default ContextLoader, default TestExecutionListeners, and their collaborators is performed by a TestContextBootstrapper, which is configured via @BootstrapWith.
items.translation: `TestContext` 的引导、默认的 `ContextLoader`、默认 `TestExecutionListeners` 及其协作对象，由 `TestContextBootstrapper` 执行，该组件通过 `@BootstrapWith` 进行配置。

items.source: Specifically, a TestContextManager is responsible for managing a single TestContext and signaling events to each registered TestExecutionListener at the following test execution points.
items.translation: 具体来说，TestContextManager 负责管理单个 TestContext，并在以下测试执行点向每个注册的 TestExecutionListener 发送事件。

items.source: This method must be called after framework-specific before lifecycle callbacks — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @BeforeEach.
items.translation: 此方法必须在框架特定的before生命周期回调之后调用——例如，带有 JUnit Jupiter 的 @BeforeEach 注解的方法。

items.source: This method must be called before framework-specific after lifecycle callbacks — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @AfterEach.
items.translation: 此方法 必须 在框架特定的后生命周期回调之前调用——例如，带有 JUnit Jupiter 的@AfterEach注解的方法。

items.source: Delegates to the supplied TestContextBootstrapper for building the TestContext and retrieving the TestExecutionListeners.
items.translation: 委托给提供的TestContextBootstrapper以构建TestContext并检索TestExecutionListeners。

items.source: An attempt will be made to give each registered TestExecutionListener a chance to pre-process the test class execution. If a listener throws an exception, however, the remaining registered listeners will not be called.
items.translation: 将尝试为每个已注册的TestExecutionListener提供机会，以预处理测试类执行。然而，如果某个监听器抛出异常，则剩余的已注册监听器将不会被调用。

items.source: The managed TestContext will be updated with the supplied testInstance.
items.translation: 受管理的TestContext将使用提供的testInstance进行更新。

items.source: An attempt will be made to give each registered TestExecutionListener a chance to prepare the test instance. If a listener throws an exception, however, the remaining registered listeners will not be called.
items.translation: 将尝试为每个已注册的TestExecutionListener提供机会来准备测试实例。然而，如果某个监听器抛出异常，则剩余的已注册监听器将不会被调用。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, this method also ensures that the application context for the current TestContext is marked as unused.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，此方法还会确保当前 TestContext 的应用上下文被标记为未使用。

items.source: This method should be called immediately after instantiation of the test class or as soon after instantiation as possible (as is the case with the SpringMethodRule). In any case, this method must be called prior to any framework-specific lifecycle callbacks.
items.translation: 此方法应在测试类实例化后立即调用，或尽可能在实例化后尽快调用（正如SpringMethodRule的情况）。无论如何，此方法必须在任何框架特定的生命周期回调之前调用。

items.source:
Allows for modifications, for example, adding a listener to the beginning of the list.
However, make sure to keep the list stable while actually executing tests.
items.translation: 允许进行修改，例如在列表开头添加监听器。然而，在执行测试时请确保保持列表的稳定性。

items.source: Construct a new TestContextManager using the supplied TestContextBootstrapper and register the necessary TestExecutionListeners.
items.translation: 使用提供的TestContextBootstrapper构建一个新的TestContextManager，并注册必要的TestExecutionListeners。

items.source: Hook for post-processing a test immediately after execution of the test method in the supplied test context — for example, for timing or logging purposes.
items.translation: 用于在提供的 测试上下文 中执行的 测试方法 执行后 立即 进行后处理的钩子——例如，用于计时或记录日志。

items.source: Hook for pre-processing a test immediately before execution of the test method in the supplied test context — for example, for timing or logging purposes.
items.translation: 用于在提供的 测试上下文 中执行的 测试方法 执行之前立即对测试进行预处理的钩子——例如，用于计时或记录日志。

items.source: Get the current TestExecutionListeners registered for this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 获取当前为这个TestContextManager注册的TestExecutionListeners。

items.source: before test class execution: prior to any before class callbacks of a particular testing framework — for example, JUnit Jupiter's @BeforeAll
items.translation: 在测试类执行之前：在任何特定测试框架的类前回调之前——例如，JUnit Jupiter 的 @BeforeAll

items.source: before test setup: prior to any before method callbacks of a particular testing framework — for example, JUnit Jupiter's @BeforeEach
items.translation: before test setup: 在特定测试框架的任何 before 方法回调 之前——例如，JUnit Jupiter 的 @BeforeEach

items.source: after test tear down: after any after method callbacks of a particular testing framework — for example, JUnit Jupiter's @AfterEach
items.translation: 测试后清理： 在特定测试框架的任何 后置方法回调 之后—— 例如，JUnit Jupiter 的 @AfterEach

items.source: after test class execution: after any after class callbacks of a particular testing framework — for example, JUnit Jupiter's @AfterAll
items.translation: after test class execution：在特定测试框架的任何after class callbacks之后——例如，JUnit Jupiter 的 @AfterAll

items.source: before test execution: immediately before execution of the test method but after test setup
items.translation: before test execution: 在 测试方法 执行之前立即运行，但在测试设置之后

items.source: after test execution: immediately after execution of the test method but before test tear down
items.translation: after test execution: 在 测试方法 执行之后立即进行，但在测试清理之前

items.source: test instance preparation: immediately following instantiation of the test class
items.translation: 测试实例准备 : 在测试类实例化之后立即执行。

items.source: Exception - if a registered TestExecutionListener throws an exception
items.translation: Exception - 如果已注册的 TestExecutionListener 抛出异常

items.source: exception - the exception that was thrown during execution of the test method or by a TestExecutionListener, or null if none was thrown
items.translation: exception - 在测试方法执行期间抛出或由 TestExecutionListener 抛出的异常，或者如果没有抛出任何异常则为 null

items.source: exception - the exception that was thrown during execution of the test method or by a TestExecutionListener, or null if none was thrown
items.translation: exception - 在测试方法执行期间抛出或由 TestExecutionListener 抛出的异常，或者如果没有抛出异常则为 null

items.source: testClass - the test class to be managed
items.translation: testClass - 要管理的测试类

items.source: testContextBootstrapper - the bootstrapper to use
items.translation: testContextBootstrapper - 要使用的引导器

items.source: testInstance - the test instance to prepare
items.translation: testInstance - 要准备的测试实例

items.source: testMethod - the test method which has just been executed on the test instance
items.translation: testMethod - 刚刚在测试实例上执行的测试方法

items.source: Construct a new TestContextManager for the supplied test class.
items.translation: 为提供的测试类构建一个新的TestContextManager。

items.source: Hook for post-processing a test after execution of after lifecycle callbacks of the underlying test framework — for example, tearing down test fixtures, ending a transaction, etc.
items.translation: 用于在底层测试框架的after生命周期回调执行后对测试进行后处理的钩子——例如，拆除测试夹具、结束事务等。

items.source: Hook for pre-processing a test before execution of before lifecycle callbacks of the underlying test framework — for example, setting up test fixtures, starting a transaction, etc.
items.translation: 用于在底层测试框架的before生命周期回调执行之前对测试进行预处理的钩子——例如，设置测试夹具、启动事务等。

items.source: Hook for post-processing a test class after execution of all tests within the class.
items.translation: 用于在类中所有测试执行之后对测试类进行后处理的钩子。

items.source: Hook for pre-processing a test class before execution of any tests within the class.
items.translation: 用于在类中任何测试执行之前对测试类进行预处理的钩子。

items.source:
Hook for preparing a test instance prior to execution of any individual
test methods — for example, to inject dependencies.
items.translation: 用于在执行任何单个测试方法之前准备测试实例的钩子——例如，用于注入依赖项。

items.source: Sam Brannen, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Sam Brannen，Juergen Hoeller
